title: The Nine Gates: Customer Journey Framework | CXWorks
description: The Nine Gates framework maps every step from Cited to Clicked to Chosen, so you can find the earliest gate where your eCommerce journey loses customers.

blocks.b: Fix the earliest one that fails.
blocks.lead: Cited, Clicked, Chosen. Every customer passes through nine gates. Fixing a later gate while an earlier one fails is money spent in the wrong place.

blocks.h: Each gate, with an example for both doors.
Three stages. Nine gates. One order.

items: One shared language for every team and agency
Spend goes to the gate that actually fails
Progress you can score and track monthly

blocks.h: Why the earliest gate matters most
paras: The Nine Gates are the steps every buyer passes through online. Cited: discoverability and findability. Clicked: relevance, clarity and usability. Chosen: trust, conversion, assistance and retention.
Each gate can be measured, and each one caps the next. If buyers cannot discover you, nothing else matters. If they find you but cannot find the right product, a better checkout will not help.
That is why we always fix the earliest gate that fails. It gives the biggest lift for the effort and makes every later fix work harder.
A free AI scan gives you a first Nine Gate score. A DCX Audit measures every gate in depth and prices the leak at each one.

blocks.p: Free AI scan in about 48 hours.
